title: Grilled Salmon with Tomato and Avocado Salad
blurb: Grilled salmon fillets served with a fresh salad of avocado, tomatoes and red onion
steps: Pat the salmon fillets dry with kitchen paper and season both sides with half the salt and half the black pepper.
Heat your grill to high and brush the salmon lightly with a little of the olive oil.
Grill the salmon for 4 to 5 minutes on each side until cooked through and lightly charred.
While the salmon cooks, halve the avocados, remove the stones and scoop out the flesh, then cut into small dice.
Halve the grape tomatoes and finely chop the red onion and coriander.
In a bowl, combine the avocado, tomatoes, red onion and coriander with the lime juice, remaining olive oil, remaining salt and remaining black pepper, then toss gently.
Divide the salad between four plates and top each with a grilled salmon fillet.
